tb21_profile.skill: End-to-end Python packaging plumbing: author a distributable package whose metadata (name, version, root __init__ exports) is exactly right, build a wheel/sdist, stand up a PEP 503 simple index over HTTP on a chosen port, and install back through pip --index-url
tb21_profile.domain: Python packaging ecosystem - setuptools/pyproject.toml, build, pip index resolution, pypiserver/PEP 503, a local HTTP service on port 8080
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging plus configure-a-service, verified by an end-to-end round trip (pip install from your own server, then import and call)

verifier_notes: CORRECTION PASS (fix-team 03, verifier_strength.json now authoritative). task_05331 ('Create a Local PyPI Repository Index Without Mirroring') was held out only by the stale FREE grade; it is `ok` (12 tests, strength 0.333) and is now promoted to rank 9. I read its tests: beyond the existence checks they require the root index.html to anchor-link both projects, each project index to link the exact sdist/wheel filenames, every index to contain real <a href=...> tags, and project directory names to be PEP 503-normalised. Those are checks on the artifact that IS the deliverable, so there is little room to satisfy them without generating a correct simple index. On merit it is the only task in the pool that builds the PEP 503 index format itself, which is precisely what the server on :8080/simple must emit for `pip install --index-url` to resolve vectorops==0.1.0. It displaces task_13067 (overall 3), an explain-the-difference-between---find-links-and---index-url exercise: the same subject matter but no artifact built and no service stood up. Terminal-Lego keeps its single slot, now with its better item. Retained from the original pass: the packet's verifier field and verifier_strength.json disagree on roughly a quarter of shown candidates. TMax task_003677_f4f9c42a also flipped (FREE -> strong) but the original pass dropped it from per_source entirely, so it is not eligible for final_top10 without re-opening per_source, which this pass leaves untouched. All seven Recursive-Task-Synthesis picks are graded 'absent' because that corpus ships no verifier in our copy; three of them are nonetheless the closest tasks in the entire pool, and the spec permits 'absent' in final_top10, so they remain promoted.

notes: This is the one task of my five where an OLD corpus wins outright. Recursive-Task-Synthesis contains roughly thirty near-identical tasks built on 'start a local PyPI server on http://localhost:8080/ and pip-install myutility_internal from it', and three of them (9173775e, 173dafbc, 7f4fd9a0) additionally build the wheel from source first, which makes them a step-for-step match for this TB2.1 task - closer than anything in either new corpus. TerminalWorld carries the seed of that same family (tw_485539). Retrieval surfaced almost none of it: the packet's RTS shortlist was benchmark/portfolio noise, and I found the family by searching for 'pypiserver|devpi|local pypi|index-url'. The new corpora are still strong but on the other half of the task: CalibForge has a large, uniformly well-verified family of Python-packaging repair tasks (software-engineering_*_020/_007/_009 - pyproject migration, src layout, entry points, pip install failures) that teach getting a package's metadata right, and nothing about index servers; Terminal-Lego has a pip-configuration cluster covering --index-url semantics, including the best simple-index task in the pool (task_05331, PEP 503 index generation) which I could not promote because the packet grades it FREE. Two caveats for the merge: (1) the RTS family is homogeneous, so three of them is already the point of diminishing returns and all thirty share one fictional package; (2) all RTS entries are 'absent' verifier, so if the merge wants graded coverage of the serving half, tw_485539 and pypa__bandersnatch-1557 are the graded substitutes. SWE-Smith is the only genuinely weak corpus here - it has no packaging or index task at all, so its ranks 6-10 are filler at overall 1-2.
